fewerWorkersOne: Limited memory: analysis uses 1 process instead of {wanted}, so that all the {megapixels} frames fit. It will take a little longer.
fewerWorkersOther: Limited memory: analysis uses {count} processes instead of {wanted}, so that all the {megapixels} frames fit. It will take a little longer.
insufficient: Not enough memory to stack {count} frames of {megapixels}: about {needed} is needed and {available} is available.
maxFrames: At most {count} fit: exclude the extra frames from the library (for example the worst ones) and stack in several runs, or close other programs and try again.
notEvenTwo: Not even two frames fit: close other programs and try again.
calibrationMasters: The calibration library masters take up another {size}.
